mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_email_verification WHERE target = #{target} AND purpose = #{purpose}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_email_verification (target, purpose, code, expire_dt) VALUES (#{target}, #{purpose}, #{code}, NOW() + (#{ttlMin} || ' minutes')::interval)
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(attempt_cnt, 0) FROM t_email_verification WHERE target = #{target} AND purpose = #{purpose} ORDER BY verify_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - reg_dt))::int FROM t_email_verification WHERE target = #{target} AND purpose = #{purpose} ORDER BY verify_id DESC LIMIT 1
